Definition: A row of menu names along the top of a window.
A list of commands that opens when you choose a name on the menu bar.
A menu inside another menu. It opens to the side of the item that holds it.
One entry in a menu bar or menu. It is either a command or the name of a submenu.
A single letter that chooses a menu item when the menu has the keyboard focus.
A key combination such as Ctrl+D that runs a menu command without opening the menu.
